relationships.subject: BCTC
relationships.evidence_quote: BCTC in heated infusions reduced the maximally occurring pain rating from 29.2 to 22.2 (P < 0.0001; Fig. 4I).

relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: The only ion channel that could be confirmed as a heat sensor in humans in this study is TRPV1

key_findings: In humans only TRPV1 (not TRPA1, TRPM3, ANO1) contributes to noxious heat pain, shifting detection by about 1 C and explaining less than 50% of heat-induced pain
Combined antagonism showed no supra-additive redundancy, implying additional unknown human heat sensors
